_README: CAPTURED, NOT WRITTEN. Regenerate with: cd backend && npm run capture:coldopen

original.request: I want to run a full marathon in 3 weeks. I have never run before in my life.

counter.statement: Run a full marathon 12 months from now — starting with a 5K in 10 weeks, then a half marathon around month 6, building to the 42.2K on a proper base.
counter.subtitle: The distance is yours to take — just not in three weeks. Give it a year.

risk.line: Zero running history plus a 3-week deadline is the exact recipe for injury — that's priced in.
risk.detail: The 3% on the original ask isn't doubt about you; it's the near-certainty that tendons and bones can't adapt in 21 days. That risk is why the number is what it is, and why the timeline moves.
